_doc: Pirate first-job cards (#186). Tier A: 20 canonical skill levels. Tier C: learn/rank weights 4/3 for attacks and 2/2 for Bullet Time; behaviour weight 2, +1 target or pierce per step, at most 3 steps. Shared Potential magnitudes apply; every card follows the weapon held at draw time. First-job cards stay on offer for both branches through requires.carry_jobs [510, 520] (spec #165 #180 shape): they list job 500 only in requires.jobs, so the advancement draw of a second job offers that branch's own skills, never the first-job ones. Second-job cards (#189: Improve MaxHP, Knuckler Mastery/Booster for the Brawler, Gun Mastery/Booster for the Gunslinger) require their exact branch and, through the skill, the matching held weapon family; they are not power cards; weights 2/2 and the 10/20 canonical ranks are tier A/C; magnitudes are the shared Potential table. Untuned.
